715420102.text: As you can see, I have successfully directed Bloom Pruner: Radiant Wings to victory over the final foe of "Shuyu's Baffling Beetle Battle Bowl"...

715420103.text: Could you now impart upon me some fundamentals of the mechanical arts...?

715420105.text: You'll need a foundation in mathematics and engineering if you want to study the mechanical arts, so let me find you some textbooks and give you a couple more sets of test questions.

715420106.text: Actually, hang on a moment. How did the Beetle Battle get named after me, again?

715420107.text: I've heard about the previous iterations of the event. Weren't they all named after your big bro Itto?

715420108.text: That is how things used to be, yes, but considering the Oni King's personality, he'd likely say—

715420109.text: "Bloom Pruner's my nemesis, a foe I must defeat! Any tournament with my name on it has gotta have Crimson Staff take center stage!"

715420110.text: Besides, it was thanks to you that this mystical beetle battle trial could be implemented at all, Master Shuyu, so of course your name should be on it!

715420111.text: Well, I wouldn't call myself much more than a middleman, passing your requests onto Master Xianyun and Madame Ping — they're the ones you should be thanking.

715420112.text: Of course, you don't have to send anything like that Semi-Automatic Tea Grinder... or whatever it was called, alright?

715420113.text: First, we wouldn't want you to break the bank for our sakes, and second, neither Master Xianyun nor Madame Ping really drinks much matcha in the first place.

715420114.text: Understood! Next time, I'll be sure to select a gift that better suits Master of Masters Xianyun and Adeptus Ping!

715420115.text: I—Is Paimon still asleep or something... Is Grandmaster Hanakado seriously having a discussion about "Masters" and "mechanics" with Xianyun's disciple, Shuyu?

715420119.text: #Huh, that sounds like... Is that you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon?

715420120.text: Oh, if it isn't the Oni King's Right Hand and Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon! Well met, well met!

715420121.text: In case you've forgotten my humble person, allow me to introduce myself...

715420122.text: We have crossed paths before, during the Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl and the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp.
